During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''Torpedo Sphere''' was undergoing refit and upgrade at the [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. Under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Edric Darius]], the Sphere had its weapons and primary [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] offline, and the crew were not present, replaced by 14,000 [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and guards. While at [[Tallaan]], the Torpedo Sphere became the target of both the [[Justice Action Network]] and the [[Pelagia Freedom Force]].
